name: Bloodlust
text: Bonded (The Hungering Blade). Revelation - Remove 2 offerings from The Hungering Blade to attach Bloodlust to it. If you cannot, take 1 horror and shuffle Bloodlust back into your deck. [fast] While attacking with The Hungering Blade, shuffle Bloodlust into your deck: You deal +1 damage for this attack. (Max once per attack.)
text_cn: 绑定(渴血之刃)。 显现 - 从渴血之刃移除2贡品来叠加嗜血到其上。如果你不能这么做，受到1点恐惧并将嗜血混洗回你的牌堆。 [free]用渴血之刃攻击时，将嗜血混洗入你的牌堆：这次攻击你造成+1伤害。(每次攻击最多一次。)
